Karnataka HC Halts Police Probes in Voter Deletion Cases

The Karnataka High Court has stayed police investigations into three additional cases concerning the alleged fraudulent use of Form 7 to delete Muslim voters. This follows earlier orders where the court had already halted similar probes. The allegations involve the improper removal of voters from electoral rolls.
